problem.passage:
The Baltimore oriole, a songbird common in eastern North America, weaves a remarkable hanging nest from plant fibers, grass, and even string scavenged from human settlements. Unlike the open cup nests built by many other songbirds, the oriole's nest is a deep, sock-like pouch suspended from the tip of a slender branch, often high in an elm or cottonwood tree. This design places the nest beyond the reach of climbing predators such as squirrels and snakes, which cannot easily traverse the thin, swaying twigs that support it. The pouch shape also shields eggs and nestlings from wind and rain more effectively than a shallow cup would. Ornithologists who have studied the species note that the female, who does nearly all of the weaving, can take up to a week to complete a single nest, tying thousands of individual fibers into knots and loops without any tool but her beak.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

problem.question: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?
options: To argue that the Baltimore oriole is more vulnerable to predators than other songbirds
To describe the distinctive structure of the Baltimore oriole's nest and explain the advantages of its design
To compare the nest-building skills of male and female Baltimore orioles
To trace the historical decline of Baltimore oriole populations in eastern North America
problem.explanation: 지문은 첫 문장부터 마지막 문장까지 오리올의 둥지가 왜 독특한 모양(주머니형)을 가졌는지, 그리고 그 모양이 포식자 회피와 비바람 차단에 어떻게 도움이 되는지를 설명한다. 마지막 문장의 암컷의 제작 과정은 이 구조의 정교함을 뒷받침하는 세부 사항일 뿐 전체 목적은 아니다. 따라서 정답은 B이다. A는 지문과 반대로 둥지 구조가 포식자를 막아준다는 내용이므로 인과관계를 뒤집었다. C는 마지막 문장의 세부 정보(암컷이 대부분 짓는다)를 과도하게 확대해 비교로 오인한 것이다. D는 지문에 전혀 언급되지 않은 개체수 감소를 다룬다.
problem.explanationEn: The passage, from beginning to end, explains why the oriole's nest has its distinctive pouch shape and how that shape helps the bird avoid predators and withstand weather. The final sentence about the female's construction process is a supporting detail about the nest's intricacy, not the main point. So B is correct. A reverses the actual cause-and-effect relationship, since the nest structure protects against predators rather than making the bird more vulnerable. C overextends a minor detail (the female does most of the weaving) into a false comparison between sexes. D introduces population decline, which is never mentioned in the text.
problem.evidenceSpan: the oriole's nest is a deep, sock-like pouch suspended from the tip of a slender branch, often high in an elm or cottonwood tree
problem.answerRationale: 지문 전체가 오리올 둥지의 독특한 구조를 묘사하고 그 구조가 포식자 회피와 기상 보호에 어떻게 유리한지 설명하는 데 집중되어 있으므로, 이 서술이 지문 전체의 중심 주장 역할을 한다.
